name: Keizudo: Duels of Love
source:
Four people have been granted by a mysterious corporation the power to use giant robots powerful enough to take over the world. Those robots are called Keizudo. The four chosen ones all have completely different views of what would be an ideal world. Therefore, they must fight each other to determine who is the worthiest to rule the world.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1364460/Keizudo/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一家神秘公司授予四人使用强大到足以统治世界的巨型机器人的能力。这些机器人被称为Keizudo。四位被选中的人对理想世界有着完全不同的看法。因此，他们必须互相争斗，以确定谁最有资格统治世界。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1364460/Keizudo/]Steam[/url]]
